meta_description: Electromark is a trusted electrician in Newcastle. NICEIC certified. Emergency callouts, rewires, fault finding. Call 07803 204597 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Blown fuse at 11pm in Whickham? We're on call round the clock to fix faults fast and safely.
services_heading: Electrical Services Across Newcastle and Gateshead
services_subhead: From emergency fault diagnosis to complete house rewires, we handle every electrical job with precision and care.

services.title: Emergency Callouts
services.desc: Power cuts, blown fuses, tripped circuits — we attend urgent electrical faults in under an hour, any time of day or night. No call-out charge.

services.title: Fault Finding & Diagnostics
services.desc: Flickering lights, dead sockets, burning smells? We track down electrical faults quickly and explain the fix before we start work.

services.title: Complete House Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring? We replace it safely to modern Building Regs. Takes 3–5 days and comes with a 10-year guarantee on all work.

services.title: Socket & Switch Installation
services.desc: Extra sockets, USB outlets, smart switches — installed to code and tested. Perfect for kitchens, home offices, and living spaces.

services.title: Lighting Design & Installation
services.desc: New ceiling lights, spotlights, dimmers, and outdoor lighting. We advise on placement and brightness to suit your needs.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Electrics
services.desc: Wiring for new boilers, immersions, and underfloor heating systems. We work with plumbers and installers to get it right first time.

about_pullquote: I started Electromark because I got tired of dodgy repairs. We do it properly.
about_para_1: Electromark was founded in 2009 by Mark Stevens, a qualified electrician and NICEIC Approved Contractor. Over 15 years, we've built a solid reputation across Newcastle, Gateshead, and Whickham by turning up on time, explaining the work honestly, and never cutting corners. Every job is carried out to current Building Regulations and covered by a comprehensive guarantee.
about_para_2: Our customers keep coming back because we answer the phone, arrive when we say we will, and charge fair prices with no hidden fees. We're local, we're approachable, and we treat every home with the same care we'd give our own. From a simple socket replacement to a full rewire, we've got the knowledge and the tools to get it done right.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Electromark

reviews.text: Called Electromark at 10pm because our kitchen lights had tripped and wouldn't come back on. Mark was here by 10:45, diagnosed a dodgy socket, replaced it, and tested everything. Charged £95 all in. Brilliant service and a really professional bloke. Wouldn't hesitate to use again.
reviews.author: Paul H.

reviews.text: Had Electromark rewire our 1970s terrace before selling. Mark was honest about what needed doing, the lads worked cleanly, and the whole thing took four days. Now we've got an EICR certificate and the buyers' surveyor was happy. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Lisa B.

reviews.text: Can't fault the service. Mark came out to find a fault in our downstairs wiring — he spent time tracking it down properly rather than just guessing. Fixed it on the spot, explained what had gone wrong, and gave us a guarantee certificate. This is how it should be done.
reviews.author: Robert T.
